senses.en: (AmE) a ceremony at which university, college, or high school students receive their diplomas
examples: The high school [[commencement]] speaker was giving a rather inspiring address.
Would passengers please turn off their mobile phones before the [[commencement]] of the flight?

senses.en: the beginning of sth.
examples: The high school [[commencement]] speaker was giving a rather inspiring address.
Would passengers please turn off their mobile phones before the [[commencement]] of the flight?

senses.en: (AmE) all the teachers in a university
examples: A drop in enrollment (招生人数) will affect students, [[faculty]], and administrators.
These plans were part of a reorganization that divided the university into six [[faculties]].

senses.en: a department or group of related departments within a university
examples: A drop in enrollment (招生人数) will affect students, [[faculty]], and administrators.
These plans were part of a reorganization that divided the university into six [[faculties]].

senses.en: deal with a problem or difficult situation
examples: You must [[confront]] your fears and doubts and take risks again and again.
Here are some problems that have [[confronted]] scientists all over the world in the past decade.

senses.zh: （问题或困境）临到···头上；使面对
senses.en: (of a problem or difficult situation) appear and need to be dealt with by sb.
examples: You must [[confront]] your fears and doubts and take risks again and again.
Here are some problems that have [[confronted]] scientists all over the world in the past decade.

senses.zh: 遇到困难就放弃的人；半途而废的人
senses.en: (infml.) sb. who does not have the determination or courage to finish sth. that is difficult
examples: I have asked you to do this tough task because I know you are not a [[quitter]].

senses.en: not very good
examples: Tourists crowd the gift shops along the street to buy [[mediocre]] products at high prices.

senses.zh: 马虎的，随便的，草率的（含贬义）
senses.en: done too quickly and carelessly — used to show disapproval
examples: She complained that the research project was delayed mainly due to [[slipshod]] management.

senses.en: willing to forgive
examples: The public was more [[forgiving]] of the president's mistakes than the press and fellow politicians.

senses.en: a date or time by which you have to do or complete sth.
examples: Without extra help, it's going to be very difficult for us to meet the Friday [[deadline]].

senses.zh: （尤指对琐事）喋喋不休的，饶舌的
senses.en: talking too much, esp. about unimportant things
examples: I had talked too much about myself and felt like a [[garrulous]] old fool.

senses.en: throw sth., esp. sth. light, with a quick gentle movement of your hand
examples: She picked up the package and casually [[tossed]] it into her handbag.

senses.en: slow in understanding; stupid
examples: It's such a simple question. If you don't understand then you are [[duller]] than I thought.
The documentary lasts for more than two-and-a-half hours, and there is scarcely a [[dull]] minute.

senses.zh: 无趣味的；不刺激的；不生动的
senses.en: not interesting or exciting
examples: It's such a simple question. If you don't understand then you are [[duller]] than I thought.
The documentary lasts for more than two-and-a-half hours, and there is scarcely a [[dull]] minute.

senses.zh: 无创意的；缺乏想象力的
senses.en: not new, original, or clever; not showing any imagination
examples: He simply couldn't understand why she thought him to be a stiff and [[unimaginative]] person.

senses.en: an exciting and unusual experience or situation that you imagine happening to you, but which will probably never happen
examples: Young children sometimes cannot distinguish between [[fantasy]] and reality.

senses.en: (BrE pretence) a way of behaving which is intended to make people believe sth. that is not true
examples: Now that the [[pretense]] was over, he could tell them what he really thought.

senses.zh: 依照传统的；符合习俗的
senses.en: (usu. before noun) following what is traditional or the way sth. has been done for a long time
examples: It's not a hotel, in the [[conventional]] sense, but rather a whole village turned into a hotel.

senses.en: have a bad effect on sth. so that it is no longer attractive, enjoyable, useful, etc.
examples: They had an entire week, so there was no need to rush into a conversation that might [[spoil]] everything.

senses.en: (~ sb. of sth.) prevent sb. from having sth., esp. sth. that they need or should have
examples: Some people worry that the advances in information technology may [[deprive]] citizens of their privacy.

senses.zh: 足够的；充分的；合乎需要的
senses.en: enough in quantity or of a good enough quality for a particular purpose
examples: The lunchtime menu is more than [[adequate]] to satisfy the biggest appetite.

senses.en: helpful; making sure that people have what they need
examples: It is an excellent childcare center for babies as the staff are friendly, relaxed and [[attentive]].
People who watch news tend to be more [[attentive]] to what is on the screen.

senses.en: listening or watching carefully and with interest
examples: It is an excellent childcare center for babies as the staff are friendly, relaxed and [[attentive]].
People who watch news tend to be more [[attentive]] to what is on the screen.

senses.en: sb. who works with you and has a similar position
examples: The manual explains what to do if a [[co-worker]] is injured and in need of medical attention.

senses.en: offend sb. by saying or doing sth. they think is rude
examples: In some cultures, you [[insult]] your host if you do not accept their offer of food.

senses.zh: 状况极坏的；非常危险的
senses.en: (fml.) in a very bad or dangerous condition
examples: Relations between the two countries have been in a [[parlous]] state for some time.

senses.en: allow people to do, say, or believe sth. without criticizing or punishing them
examples: According to the spokesperson, the government is not prepared to [[tolerate]] the situation any longer.
For years the workers have had to [[tolerate]] low wages and terrible working conditions.

senses.en: be able to accept sth. unpleasant or difficult, even though you do not like it
examples: According to the spokesperson, the government is not prepared to [[tolerate]] the situation any longer.
For years the workers have had to [[tolerate]] low wages and terrible working conditions.

senses.zh: 青少年（常指12至18岁之间的人）
senses.en: a young person, usu. between the ages of 12 and 18, who is developing into an adult
examples: We know that [[adolescents]] are neither children nor adults and they have specific developmental needs.

senses.zh: 设法忘记，抛弃（已学会的东西）
senses.en: (infml.) deliberately forget sth. you have learned, in order to change the way you do sth.
examples: You must start by [[unlearning]] all the bad habits your previous piano teacher taught you!

senses.en: (only before noun) done in order to get ready for sth.
examples: Months of [[preparatory]] work needs to be done before construction work can really begin.

senses.en: think carefully about what to say, and say it clearly
examples: She has lots of good ideas, but she has difficulty [[formulating]] them in front of investors.
The city government is currently [[formulating]] policies on road expansion to solve traffic problems.

senses.en: develop sth. such as a plan or a set of rules, and decide all the details of how it will be done
examples: She has lots of good ideas, but she has difficulty [[formulating]] them in front of investors.
The city government is currently [[formulating]] policies on road expansion to solve traffic problems.

senses.en: allowing people to do, say, or believe what they want without criticizing or punishing them
examples: My friends are more [[tolerant]], more willing to accept me for what I am.

senses.zh: 增长（知识、经验等）；扩大（活动范围等）
senses.en: increase sth. such as your knowledge, experience, or range of activities
examples: The course helps school-leavers [[broaden]] their knowledge of the world of work.

senses.zh: 据说；据称；一般相信；一般看来
senses.en: used when saying what many people say or believe is true, esp. when you disagree with them
examples: He was [[supposedly]] delivering some papers to her but I think it was just an excuse to see her.

senses.en: remove sth. completely
examples: Mr. Woods wants a convincing victory to [[erase]] doubts about his team's ability.
It appears the names were accidentally [[erased]] from the computer hard drive.

senses.zh: 删除（计算机文件）；抹去（磁带录音）
senses.en: remove information from a computer memory or recorded sounds from a tape
examples: Mr. Woods wants a convincing victory to [[erase]] doubts about his team's ability.
It appears the names were accidentally [[erased]] from the computer hard drive.

senses.zh: （尤指美国中学和大学的）一学期，半学年
senses.en: one of the two periods of time that a year at high schools and universities is divided into, esp. in the US
examples: I was finishing my last [[semester]] in college and trying to look for a job in my hometown.

senses.zh: 期中考试2) the middle period of an elected government's time in power （政府任期的）中期
senses.en: (AmE) a test that students take in the middle of a semester or quarter
examples: A commitment to making reforms to the care system will form part of tomorrow's [[midterm]] progress report.

senses.en: (AmE) an important test that you take at the end of a particular class in high school or college
examples: He's through to the men's tennis [[final]] for the first time in his career.

senses.en: the last and most important game, race, or set of games in a competition
examples: He's through to the men's tennis [[final]] for the first time in his career.

senses.zh: 预定的；预期发生（到达）的
senses.en: (not before noun) expected to happen or arrive at a particular time
examples: They suddenly gave up the deal the day before they were [[due]] to sign the contract.

senses.en: leave a school or university before your course has finished
examples: To everyone's surprise, Bill [[dropped]] out of college after his first year and joined a rock-and-roll band.

senses.en: think about sth. that happened in the past
examples: When you [[look]] back on this experience in a year or two, it won't seem so bad.

senses.en: what is easiest in a difficult situation
examples: It is the easy way out to blame others for our failure though it doesn't make any sense.

senses.zh: 用行动来表现情绪（尤指愤怒或紧张）
senses.en: express your feelings about sth. through your behavior or actions, esp. when you have been feeling angry or nervous
examples: These teenagers are likely to [[act]] out their feelings of insecurity by being moody and aggressive.

senses.en: have taken action so that sb. / sth. is no longer there to worry or annoy you
examples: He found his job tedious and time-consuming and he was glad to [[be]] [[rid]] of it.

senses.en: suddenly think of sth.
examples: List the product's strengths as well as weaknesses at random as they [[pop]] into your mind.

senses.en: not to be caught or punished when you have done sth. wrong
examples: It's time they put a stop to his bad behavior. He's been [[getting]] away with it for too long.

senses.zh: 开始认真对待；开始努力做
senses.en: start to direct your efforts and attention to sth., esp. work
examples: That's a tourism hotspot. I must [[get]] down to booking the hotel as soon as possible.

senses.en: not at all
examples: It is by no means clear where the money is going to come from to fund this project.
